#### `This is the heart of smart objects working with motion matching, this task will run until a good animation has been found or until your reach your end destination of a move. Once that is done it sends a message to the AC_SmartObjectAnimation component on the pawn and then listens for when the animation is completed from there. This is important because State Tree tasks are not replicated and so the component handles replication of animation data and signaling from the character that their animation is complete.` — `EdGraphNode_Comment` (`EdGraphNode_Comment_-1441_-794_4A4F385F`)

- Position: (-1441, -794)
- Node type: `Generic`
- Comment: This is the heart of smart objects working with motion matching, this task will run until a good animation has been found or until your reach your end destination of a move. Once that is done it sends a message to the AC_SmartObjectAnimation component on the pawn and then listens for when the animation is completed from there. This is important because State Tree tasks are not replicated and so the component handles replication of animation data and signaling from the character that their animation is complete.
- Pins: _none_

#### `On the server, once we've hit a distance, we motion match and play right away, we do not attempt to find the absolute best pose. This is because latency and visuals between server and the clients won't be the same and you would want to do more of this type of work on the client for that. In our experience, this still leads to good results in a networked environment.` — `EdGraphNode_Comment` (`EdGraphNode_Comment_138_-230_F51A8C76`)
